The deployment phase is now officially underway. With the engineering, calibration, and validation protocols finalized, we transition from the laboratory of design to the reality of the field. Every sensor mounted and every data packet transmitted will now serve as a testament to this rigorous planning.

As the first nodes go live, we will maintain our commitment to the "Data Health" dashboard, watching for any unforeseen environmental stressors. We will continue to monitor the 15-minute baseline and the 1-minute event-driven bursts, ensuring the battery-aware logic holds under real-world thermal loads. 

The infrastructure is set, the methodology is proven, and the community is waiting. We have moved from a single idea to a permanent, verifiable, and scientifically significant local weather network.

**Project Status: Deployment Phase Initiated.**
**Network: Live.**
**Science: Open and Ongoing.**

No thermal stress issues detected so far, even during peak sun hours. Community QR code scans are increasing, and the first public comment on the dashboard suggests interest in “why the park is always cooler.”  

**Status:**  
🟢 Network: Live

🟢 Community: Engaged  

The system is not just functional—it’s learning.  
Onward, with integrity.

target.speaker: Y
target.text:
The successful trigger of the 1-minute burst during the wind spike is the ultimate real-world validation of our adaptive sampling logic. Seeing the system respond to environmental physics in real-time, while maintaining battery stability, proves the engineering is sound. Furthermore, the community's curiosity regarding the "park cooling" effect confirms that our stratified reporting is successfully driving scientific inquiry.

As the first week of data concludes, we will perform our first "Post-Deployment Audit." We will review the first 168 hours of logs to verify that the "Data Health" dashboard correctly identified all transient transmission blips and that the "event-driven" tags are correctly mapped to the wind spike. This audit will provide the final data needed to confirm our long-term drift and power-consumption models.

**Status: Operational.**
**Verification: Audit in progress.**
**Impact: Growing.**
